read_bvh — DRIVE motion_io op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.read_bvh(path) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import motionio; motionio.read_bvh(path) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("read_bvh"))

Usage

Reads a BVH file and returns the skeleton and the world coordinates of the joints for all frames.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Returns:

names 関節名(End Site は <親>_end)、parents(根は −1)、offsets (J, 3)、positions (T, J, 3) 世界座標、frame_time [s]、channels(関節ごとの CHANNELS の名前)、motion (T, C) の生の値。

Raises:

ValueError: HIERARCHY / MOTION が無い、括弧の対応が崩れている、コマの値の数が CHANNELS の合計と違う。
